take.title: The Card and the Atlas
take.bookTitle: The making of the LEGO Odyssey

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: Before the bricks there was another film, drawn in dots on paper: the halfworld. Its record begins on the twenty-third of July, at six minutes to three in the morning.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: He means: all twenty-four books. Every scene as causes, every figure a program that draws itself. Here is the card.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Paste this into Claude, with any book. The film is the program.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Phase zero, the atlas. Phase one, the engine. Phase five, the music: optional, but transformative.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: The first commit holds four hundred and ninety-four files. Fifteen books, already finished. How they were made, the record does not say.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Each figure draws itself in flat grey. The card says: never dots. One last pass prints the frame as dots, as Knowlton printed films at Bell Labs in 1963.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: He means: build a few, verify, then fan out.
